_provenance.status: UNMEASURED placeholder, inherited from the previous hardcoded value
_provenance.applies_to: models with no meta_gate.write_size in their profile
_provenance.replace_when: the coherence sweep runs and yields a measured threshold
_provenance.enforcement: RETIRED 2026-08-22 (Opus Q1, Jake approved). The threshold is still COMPUTED and logged to state/write_size_observations.jsonl, it just no longer vetoes. Set enforce=true to restore blocking - no code change. Retired because it blocked 5,314-14,394 chars against a valid 37,422-char call (n=25), manufactured 357 lessons that outlived it, and could not prevent the failure that actually occurs at size (prose leakage - see _05_prose_leak_detector).

_provenance.purpose: suppress a captured lesson when the constraint that generated it changes
_provenance.relax_factor: a limit must relax by at least this factor before its lessons go stale; a TIGHTENED limit is never stale (the lesson is more relevant, not less)
_provenance.never_deletes: stale lessons are suppressed from surfacing and keep their file and recurrence ledger
